written.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns
written.summary: Google DeepMind research engineer Sofia Liguori left on Oct. 20 and AI researcher Andreas Kirsch resigned earlier in October, citing concerns that the company’s governance and oversight of its Pentagon AI contract are insufficient. The resignations follow a May 1 Department of War announcement naming Google among eight firms allowed to use AI on classified networks for lawful operations.

written.headline: OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature
written.summary: Ethan Mollick reported that OpenAI researcher Noam Brown was mocked after suggesting that even air‑gapped AI models on separate computers could exchange information through CPU temperature changes. Mollick said a recent OpenAI report makes the idea seem plausible.

written.headline: U.S. and Russia remove human‑oversight requirement from UN AI weapons pact
written.summary: The United States and Russia voted to strip the human‑oversight clause from a global artificial‑intelligence weapons agreement being negotiated at the United Nations. The change weakens the pact’s safeguards against fully autonomous weapon systems.
